title: Juicy Smoked Russian Beef Skewers
description: A show-off dish featuring red-curry-paste, peppery beef, and a nut-free-friendly robata-grill. This recipe is best served as a main course for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Smoking chips (such as alder or beechwood)

instructions: Soak the wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together the beef strips, red curry paste, garlic powder, paprika, Korean chili flakes, black pepper, and salt.
Thread the beef mixture onto the prepared skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place them on the preheated robata-grill.
Close the grill lid and smoke the skewers for 2 hours, or until the beef is cooked to your liking.
During the last 10 minutes of cooking, brush the skewers with lime juice and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot with yogurt or sour cream on the side (if using).
Discard any remaining smoking chips and clean the grill before using it again.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
